munich-bavarian-alps-allg-u-high-roads.slogan: A 694 km loop out of Allgäu High Roads
munich-bavarian-alps-allg-u-high-roads.story: A proper escape from Munich with roads worth waking up for. Out of Rottach-Egern and back again: 694 km, roughly 14 h 28 in the saddle. On the way it passes Scenic stretch near Schwabmünchen, near Donauwörth and Johanniskirchen. The climb of the day is near Navis. It tops out at about 1,300 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
